name: brand-creator
description: Make a logo, colours and every brand file your product needs, step by step, with you deciding at each step.

projects_root.title: Brand projects folder
projects_root.description: Folder that holds your brand projects. Leave empty to be asked each time; ./<slug>/ in the current folder is offered first.

review_surface.title: Where boards are reviewed
review_surface.description: auto asks once per project whether boards may be uploaded to claude.ai as a private Artifact page (only when the session has the Artifact tool) and uses a local file until you answer. artifact always uses an Artifact page. local always opens a local file.
